newsitem.title: USA: CommNet, AirTouch in paging deal.
newsitem.headline: CommNet, AirTouch in paging deal.

text.p: CommNet Cellular Inc said on Monday it agreed to allow AirTouch Communications Inc to offer paging services throughout CommNet's nine-state region.

CommNet said it will let AirTouch use its one-way FLEX infrastructure, which it is currently building out, to provide paging service in CommNet's cellular markets on one of AirTouch's nationwide paging frequencies.
In turn, CommNet said it will be able to sell the paging services provided over its paging network on AirTouch's nationwide paging frequency.

It will bundle local, statewide and nationwide paging services along with its existing cellular telephone service in its rural region, which includes the states of Colorado, Iowa, New Mexico and Utah.
The companies did not provide further financial information.
